decision: Full car = 'gt3 rs Full Car.stl' (25M tris), levelled with tools/level.py (ground RANSAC, 3.4 deg tilt; long axis -> Y, front = -Y), decimated 4 mm (wide) and 2.5 mm (close-ups), cropped, prepped -> car4.json; every part prepped --like car4.json
why: Raw frame had the ground tilted 3.4 deg and the car diagonal; one rigid transform (level.json) applied to every part keeps all Artec exports registered

decision: Parts registered at identity (red-over-grey renders + nearest-surface d50 2.4-7 mm): fender vent, front bumper strakes, front grille trim, front lower lip, hood vent top (warped) + interface assembled (left), rear bumper, rear bumper strake, rear diffuser 1/2, diffuser trim inner/outer, rear QP intakes 1/2, side skirt strake, side skirt upper/lower
why: Lesson: check each part over the car by rendering and looking; all z-fight with the car skin

decision: Not used: 'Porsche 911 GT3 (992) Rear Diffuser.stl', hood vent interface right/no fins, hood vent fins, Alex's Full Assembly.blend
why: 992 diffuser sits 350 mm off in another frame and is named for the non-RS GT3 (user: our scan data only); interface right/no-fins and fins sit centred under the hood in their own frame (nothing visible over the car); the 4.6 GB .blend is an assembly, not a scan state

decision: No hood/trunk/door/DRS opening beat from state scans
why: Folder has no hood/trunk/door states; Underbody 'DRS Open Rear' ICP-registered to the car differs from the closed car by <8 mm on the wing profile (no flap rotation visible) - the brief says open panels only where the state scans allow

decision: Shot order: s1 low front-left 3/4 turntable -> s2 rear-right 3/4 orbit (swan-neck wing, diffuser) -> s3 front-left wheel/brake close-up (2.5 mm) -> s4 right fender louvres close-up -> s5 swan-neck wing mounts from high behind -> s6 nose aero lifts off (lip, strakes, grille trim, left hood-vent top) -> s7 high front 3/4 up to top-down -> s8 aero explode/reassemble -> logo
why: Brief's Temerario order; s6 stands in for 'panels open' with scanned parts because no hood/trunk/door/DRS-open state exists

decision: Explode = 13 aero part scans over comp_explode4 (full car with each part's skin cut within 9 mm, tools/composite.py, no fills): lip, grille trim, front strakes, fender vent, left hood-vent top, side skirt upper/lower/strake, both QP intakes, rear bumper strake, rear diffuser, diffuser trim outer
why: Brief: aero pieces off the body is the hero beat; no 'removed' state scans exist for this car, so the base is the full car trimmed back, which leaves only small cut-outs under thin aero pieces

decision: Hood vent interface (assembled, left) stays on the car in s6/s8 instead of moving
why: In the first preview it rose as a tall bracket-like piece that does not read as a body part

decision: Fender vent stays on the car in s6 (moves only in the explode)
why: Preview: cutting it out leaves a ragged hole on the right fender in full view of the s6 camera

decision: Framing tightened after 30 % previews: s1 radius 5.4->4.9, angles 38-72 -> 24-52; s2 -150..-122 -> -158..-134; explode radius 7.0 -> 5.2-5.6 with camera 4.2-4.6 m high, orbit 48 -> -36 deg
why: Contact sheets: car read small in 9:16 and side-on ends cropped the nose; higher explode camera lays the car's length along the frame height

decision: Side skirts used uncleaned; rear diffuser keeps its undertray
why: Distance-to-car cleaning (100 mm) would have deleted the skirts' inner flanges and the diffuser undertray, which are real part surfaces the car scan never saw

decision: Music: porsche-gt3rs-992_track.mp3 (generated for this reel by the coordinating session). Grid 128 BPM, beat 0.46888 s, b(n)=0.025+0.46888n
why: ive beats/librosa kick grid disagreed by 50-110 ms; waveform attack of the big hits (-5 dB) lands at 3.777, 7.528, 11.279 = exactly 8 beats apart, so the grid is anchored on those attacks

decision: Structure on the track: big hits every 8 beats to 26.28, an early hit at 14.09 (b30), the drop at 26.28 (b56) into a dense section, music ends 36.1 s, decays to silence ~37.8 s. Cuts: 3.776, 7.527, 9.403 (weak hit), 11.278, 14.091, 18.780, 24.405 (weak hit), logo 33.784; end 38.0
why: Cut on the accents (lesson); short close-ups on the half-phrase weak hits; the explode separates ON the drop (26.28), locks on the 31.9 hit (b68) and holds 4 beats; logo takes the last 2.3 s of music and the decay

decision: Nose lift (s6) rises from 15.03 (b32) and lands on 16.90 (b36 weak hit)
why: Lands on an accent while the shot holds 4 beats open before the top-down

decision: Close-ups s3/s4 shortened to 2.0 s renders (the 1.87 s used) mid-queue
why: Close-ups with the 2.5 mm car cost ~36 s/frame; rendering 3 s and trimming wasted ~20 min

decision: Renderer resumes (use_overwrite=False, RESUME=1 render_final.sh) after the container killed the queue at s2 frame 20/59
why: Session idled and the background queue died; resuming kept 20 finished frames instead of re-rendering

decision: v1 assembled: 37.97 s, cuts measured from frame diffs at frames 113/226/282/338/423/563/732/1013 = targets; audio decays to -44 dB at 37.8 s under the logo fade
why: Verified on the delivered file (lesson: measure cuts, not just the plan)

decision: v2 scene order from direction.md (scene-director agent): whole car FL 3/4 -> FL wheel -> nose aero off -> right fender louvres -> wing mounts -> rear diffuser + QP intakes off -> left skirts off -> top overview of everything off -> layered stack on the drop + reassembly -> fade -> small logo
why: User (relayed, all V1 reels): order by this car's scan features, travel around the car once, one section per sequence, parts off section by section with the camera on that section, no wasted rotations, progressive explode, fade then small logo

decision: Turntables (v1 s1, s2), v1 top-down and the one-wide-orbit explode dropped; v1 s3_wheel and s5_wing reused

decision: Front strakes, fender vent, rear bumper strake and diffuser outer trim no longer move; base rebuilt as comp_v2 cutting only the 9 moving parts

decision: No labels in v2
why: Original brief: no text; the new label rule is for bumper-removed data, which this car does not have; part names would be the only honest wording - left for the user to ask

decision: Cuts only on onsets measured from the decoded audio; v1 cuts at 9.40/24.40 dropped
why: Those were 228 ms late: the beats are swells, the real onsets sit ~115 ms before the grid; big hits measured within +-0.45 frame

decision: Logo card shrunk to 300 px (28 % width), after a 0.9 s fade to black at the end of the reassembly
why: User (relayed): fade out, then small logo; don't hold the last scenes too long (Temerario ending)

decision: 1-frame fade transitions with +1 real frame on each outgoing clip instead of type: cut
why: type: cut clones the last frame (one duplicate frame before every cut, v1 review item 9)

decision: New renders use persistent data off; all v1 renders luma-scanned: no dropouts

decision: Cuts at 5.633 and 16.900 (strongest local peaks), not the 5.565/16.807 'medium' onsets

decision: Opener re-rendered with a visible slide (camera 38 -> 24 deg, 7.4 -> 6.6 m, linear) and 62 frames

decision: First clip has no overlap frame; sh7/sh8 at src_fps 14.5; sh3/sh6 trim_start keeps part motion on reel times after moving cuts
